events.title: World Wide Web announced publicly
events.summary: Tim Berners-Lee published the web as an open system for linked documents.

narrative.whyChosen: The web turned the internet from a specialist tool into the default public information layer.
narrative.whyImportant: URLs, HTTP, and HTML created a universal publishing model that reshaped commerce, media, and software delivery.
narrative.problemSolved: CERN researchers needed a simple way to share and link documents across different computers and networks.

sources.title: W3C — A short history of the Web
